title: saxifraga paniculata subsp. neogaea
intro: Saxifraga paniculata subsp. neogaea, commonly known as Korean rock saxifrage, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the saxifrage family native to East Asia. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The therapeutic actions of Saxifraga paniculata subsp. neogaea include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body from harm. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
